result.document_summary: A page from the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 4 (Health and Sanitation), containing rat control, mosquito control and beekeeping provisions, with no rental-housing rules in the retrieved portion.
result.notes: This part of the document (page labeled for the algorithmic rent-pricing prohibition, but containing text of San Diego Municipal Code §§ 44.0343-44.0411) covers only rat control, docks and wharves, markets, mosquito nuisances and beekeeping. None of it falls within the six in-scope categories (rent increase limits, just cause eviction, security deposits, application screening fees, screening restrictions, algorithmic rent setting). The text of the algorithmic rent-setting prohibition named in the source URL (§ 98.1103) is not included in this part, so no rule is extracted.
